title: Grievance CSV import with preview
summary: Added a two-step CSV importer on the grievance list: preview summarizes validation (project, municipality, barangay, grievance options) and skips existing case numbers; import inserts only ready rows.
changes: App/GrievanceCsvImporter.php — parse, validate, preview, and import grievance CSV rows
Help topic grievance-list updated with Import CSV action
docs/samples/grievance-import-sample.csv and public/samples/grievance-import-sample.csv — downloadable template with three example rows
Import modal returns refreshed csrf_token after preview so import POST succeeds
